en.title: Computer Troubleshooting Platform
en.aftitle1: Solve everyday computer issues with confidence.
en.aftitle2: FixHub helps you identify common problems, follow clear repair steps, and know when to ask for professional support.
en.whyUserLikeP: From slow performance to connection issues, FixHub gives you a clear path to identify the problem and choose the next step.
en.cardDiagnoseDesc: Review common problems and find simple solutions without confusion.
en.cardGuidesDesc: Follow basic tutorials for cleaning hardware, improving speed, and checking connections.
en.cardMaintenanceDesc: Learn preventive habits that help you avoid common computer problems.
en.cardSupportDesc: If the issue is more serious, the site helps you decide when a technician is the right choice.

es.whyUserLikeP: Desde rendimiento lento hasta problemas de conexión, FixHub te da un camino claro para identificar el problema y elegir el siguiente paso.
es.cardDiagnoseDesc: Revisa problemas comunes y encuentra soluciones simples sin confusiones.
es.cardGuidesDesc: Sigue tutoriales básicos para limpiar hardware, mejorar la velocidad y revisar conexiones.
